Jormungand was, according to Norse legend, the son of the Asgardian prince Loki and of the sorceress Angerboda. description_text: Fafnir, in Nordic mythology, name of the great dragon slain by Sigurd, the Norse version of the German hero Siegfreid. As told in the Volsunga saga, Fafnir slew his father, Hreithmar, to obtain the vast amount of gold which Hreithmar had demanded of Odin as a compensation for the loss of one of his sons. Odin gave the gold but put a curse on it. Full of greed, Fafnir changed into a dragon to guard his treasure and was later slain by the young hero Sigurd. Sigurd was spurred on by another brother of Fafnir, the blacksmith Regin. Once Sigurd, under the advice of Odin, had killed Fafnir, Regin asked him to cook the dragon’s heart for him. Sigurd touched the heart as it was cooking to test if it was done and burned his thumb. He put his thumb into his mouth and was then able to understand the language of birds. (In this tale, knowledge is given to one who eats the heart of a dragon.) The birds told Sigurd that it was Regin’s intention to kill him, so instead Sigurd killed Regin and left with Fafnir’s treasure.

description_text:
This product contains several useful tools for detailing, sculpting and painting all kinds of scales, like reptiles (lizards, snakes...), fishes, dragons, mermaids, and monsters:

  - 250 ZBrush brushes for shaping, texturing, and polypainting: dragrect, dragdot, draw brushes, paint freehand brushes, and paint dragrect brushes.

  - 50 PSD Alphas that you can use in Zbrush and other 3D apps that use alphas. 2048x2048 pixels, 16 bits, grayscale, in PSD and JPG, for all 3D applications.

  - 10 Surface Noise Patterns ready for ZBrush.

  - 10 fill patterns in JPG and PSD, for use in any application.

  - A PDF tutorial, and an index of the brushes.

  - A video tutorial, that you can also find on YouTube (in our channel), but is included in our product for your future reference.

  - DragRect  and DragDot brushes that you can click and drag to set the position and size of the detail.

  - Special Draw brushes that have settings to allow you to paint the details in an artistic way, as if you were drawing them. This way they have direction and uniqueness, and look natural.

  - Paint Brushes that add surface relief and texture at the same time, so you can apply this before or after using the other brushes and get a finished model, or use them to detail and paint your models at the same time.

COMPATIBLE WITH: ZBrush 2021.6.6 and up (updating from 2019 to 2022 and above is free and easy).

description_text:
Animal Eye Maker is a fast way of adding eyes to your animals. Includes 128 textures for many kinds of animals, and a plugin for quickly adding them that also allows you to select the texture and reflection map for the eyes in a visual way.Animal Eye Maker is a must have for adding eyes to your ZBrush animal and beast models. It can be used in two ways:- Automatic: install the included plugin and start adding eyes quick and easy.- Manual: use the textures, tool, reflections, and material and add them yourself.The easier and faster way is to use the included AS Animal Eye Maker Plugin inside ZBrush. It will allow you to add eyes in a moment to any model.Contents:

  - AS Animal Eye Maker Plugin for ZBrush: just click buttons for adding eyes, setting their textures, or using one of the reflection maps included. With visual selectors for textures and reflections.

  - 128 Eye textures of different kinds of animals: 3072x3072 JPG for snakes, turtles, geckos, rodents, felines, canines, primates, toads, and more. Each texture is labeled with the name of the animal for easier use.

  - 20 reflection maps in .tif format

  - An Animal Eye Tool for ZBrush, which is a spherical model already mapped to use the included textures. 

  - An Eye Material with 4 shaders: for BPR rendering, for Best rendering, reflection and sclera bump. The shader uses the included reflection maps.

description_text:
Dionaeamonstrum Titanic : Le Fléau des Marais PrimordiauxAu creux d'une faille temporelle oubliée, là où l'atmosphère s'épaissit de dioxyde de carbone et de vapeurs méphitiques, l'évolution a pris un tournant macabre. Dans ces marécages de l'ère du supercontinent, la flore a cessé de subir pour commencer à traquer. Au sommet de cette hiérarchie sanglante trône la Dionaeamonstrum titanic.
Cette entité végétale colossale n'est plus une simple plante, mais l'aboutissement d'une hyper-évolution carnassière : une machine organique conçue pour l'annihilation.
Physiologie et Concept VisuelLa Dionaeamonstrum est une fusion cauchemardesque entre la flore ancestrale et la puissance brute des grands sauriens. Son esthétique est un mélange de vie et de pétrification :
L’Armure : Son tronc est recouvert d'une écorce fossilisée aux reflets sombres, protégeant des tissus végétaux gorgés de sève et d'humidité.
Le Système Circulatoire : Un réseau de veines rouges luminescentes affleure à la surface, transportant des fluides corrosifs comme une lave biologique.
La Mâchoire : Ses pièges géants sont renforcés par des fibres de chitine. Lorsqu'ils se referment, la pression exercée rivalise avec celle du Deinosuchus. Les cils sensitifs de la dionée classique sont ici devenus des éperons osseux acérés, capables de broyer instantanément le squelette des proies les plus massives.
Mécanisme de ChasseÀ l'intérieur de la gueule béante, les parois exsudent un fluide enzymatique hyper-concentré. Ce n'est pas qu'un suc digestif ; c'est un acide volatil qui commence à liquéfier les tissus vivants dès que le piège se claque, interdisant toute forme de lutte. Le silence qui règne autour d'elle n'est pas une absence de vie, mais le résultat d'une zone de prédation totale.

Thank you for your support and look forward to more figures and maybe some custom tools in the future

description_text:
Dove-Dove of peace 3D-scanned miniature dioramaThe dove is arguably one of the most famous birds in the world. It is not only a symbol of peace in the Christian church, but also a cult feature of many cities and bird lovers.You can now print the traditional animal as a mini diorama. Whether as a decorative ornament for the table or shelf, as an eye-catcher on cups or for your tabletop gaming table the eagle is always an eye-catcher.The detailed 3D model is based on a high-resolution scan of a plastic model and was provided with additional details to make the figure look more lifelike.For easier printing we have broken the model down into several parts to guarantee best results in FDM printing as well as in SLA. After printing, the surface can be easily reworked and can be transformed into interesting, personal works of art with just a few brush strokes.We recommend printing the cutted version to achieve an impressive level of detail. Depending on your printer tolerances we recommend to adujst the size of the interconnectors in your slicer. We choose for ender 3 pro z 11mm and xy 4.5mm.This model can be used as an aid in scenes or printed on any available 3D printer.
If you also need special models, please contact us. If you need scanned objects and/or printed parts or if you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us:

description_text:
A fishing trawler is a commercial fishing vessel designed to operate fishing trawls. Trawling is a method of fishing that involves actively dragging or pulling a trawl through the water behind one or more trawlers. Trawls are fishing nets that are pulled along the bottom of the sea or in midwater at a specified depth. A trawler may also operate two or more trawl nets simultaneously (double-rig and multi-rig).
There are many variants of trawling gear. They vary according to local traditions, bottom conditions, and how large and powerful the trawling boats are. A trawling boat can be a small open boat with only 30 horsepower (22 kW) or a large factory ship with 10,000 horsepower (7457 kW). Trawl variants include beam trawls, large-opening midwater trawls, and large bottom trawls, such as rock hoppers that are rigged with heavy rubber wheels that let the net crawl over rocky bottom.

description_text:
The total number of fishing vessels in the world in 2016 was estimated to be about 4.6 million, unchanged from 2014. The fleet in Asia was the largest, consisting of 3.5 million vessels, accounting for 75 percent of the global fleet.[1] In Africa and North America the estimated number of vessels declined from 2014 by just over 30,000 and by nearly 5,000, respectively. For Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean and Oceania the numbers all increased, largely as a result of improvements in estimation procedures.
It is difficult to estimate the number of recreational fishing boats. They range in size from small dinghies to large charter cruisers, and unlike commercial fishing vessels, are often not dedicated just to fishing.
Prior to the 1950s there was little standardisation of fishing boats. Designs could vary between ports and boatyards. Traditionally boats were built of wood, but wood is not often used now because of higher maintenance costs and lower durability. Fibreglass is used increasingly in smaller fishing vessels up to 25 metres (100 tons), while steel is usually used on vessels above 25 metres.

description_text:
A lifeboat or liferaft is a small, rigid or inflatable boat carried for emergency evacuation in the event of a disaster aboard a ship. Lifeboat drills are required by law on larger commercial ships. Rafts (liferafts) are also used. In the military, a lifeboat may double as a whaleboat, dinghy, or gig. The ship's tenders of cruise ships often double as lifeboats. Recreational sailors usually carry inflatable liferafts, though a few prefer small proactive lifeboats that are harder to sink and can be sailed to safety.
Inflatable lifeboats may be equipped with auto-inflation (carbon dioxide or nitrogen) canisters or mechanical pumps. A quick release and pressure release mechanism is fitted on ships so that the canister or pump automatically inflates the lifeboat, and the lifeboat breaks free of the sinking vessel. Commercial aircraft are also required to carry auto-inflating liferafts in case of an emergency water landing; offshore oil platforms also have liferafts.
Ship-launched lifeboats are lowered from davits on a ship's deck, and are hard to sink in normal circumstances. The cover serves as protection from sun, wind and rain, can be used to collect rainwater, and is normally made of a reflective or fluorescent material that is highly visible. Lifeboats have oars, flares and mirrors for signaling, first aid supplies, and food and water for several days. Some lifeboats are more capably equipped to permit self-rescue, with supplies such as a radio, an engine and sail, heater, navigational equipment, solar water stills, rainwater catchments and fishing equipment.
The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) and the International Life-Saving Appliance Code (LSA) requires certain emergency equipment be carried on each lifeboat and liferaft used on international voyages. Modern lifeboats carry an Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacon (EPIRB) and either a radar reflector or Search and Rescue Transponder (SART).

description_text:
A modern torpedo is an underwater ranged weapon launched above or below the water surface, self-propelled towards a target, and with an explosive warhead designed to detonate either on contact with or in proximity to the target. Historically, such a device was called an automotive, automobile, locomotive, or fish torpedo; colloquially a fish. The term torpedo originally applied to a variety of devices, most of which would today be called mines. From about 1900, torpedo has been used strictly to designate a self-propelled underwater explosive device.
While the 19th-century battleship had evolved primarily with a view to engagements between armored warships with large-caliber guns, the invention and refinement of torpedoes from the 1860s onwards allowed small torpedo boats and other lighter surface vessels, submarines/submersibles, even improvised fishing boats or frogmen, and later light aircraft, to destroy large ships without the need of large guns, though sometimes at the risk of being hit by longer-range artillery fire.
One can divide modern torpedoes into lightweight and heavyweight classes; and into straight-running, autonomous homers, and wire-guided types. They can be launched from a variety of platforms.

Overview
The Moray Eel: A Marine Predator and Creature of the Deep Fantasy Fish 07 features the moray eel, a fascinating fish resembling a snake, known for its predatory nature. This ma-rine beast blends the fearsome traits of a reptile with the elegance of an aquatic predator. Imag-ine encountering a creature that combines the eerie aspects of a snake and the mystique of un-derwater life, perfect for fans of horror and fantasy.
A Sinister Underwater Enemy The moray eel is not just a fish; it's an underwater enemy, a beast that haunts the tropical and temperate seas. Inspired by legendary sea monsters like the Kraken and Leviathan, this model captures the essence of an alien marine monster, making it a formidable foe in any oceanic adventure.
Explore the Aquatic World Fantasy Fish 07 invites you to explore the underwater realm, from vibrant tropical reefs to the dark, unexplored corners of the ocean. The realistic animations and textures reveal the hidden beauty and lurking horror beneath the sea, creating a captivating and thrilling visual journey.
A Marvel of 3D Artwork This 3D model is a true masterpiece, combining advanced tech-nology with artistic creativity. The lifelike portrayal of the moray eel, with its smooth, sinuous movements and detailed textures, offers an immersive experience that will captivate anyone fascinated by marine life and horror themes.
Conservation Through Creativity While Fantasy Fish 07 delves into the darker side of the ocean, it also highlights the importance of marine conservation. By bringing attention to the beauty and fragility of our seas, this model encourages a deeper appreciation for the underwater world, promoting efforts to protect our aquatic ecosystems from the shallows to the deep sea.

This 3D model is a Hamster Plastic Tunnel Box
Made in Blender 2.9x (Cycles Materials) and Rendering Cycles. Main rendering made in Blender 2.9 + Cycles using some HDR Environment Textures Images for lighting and a three-light lighting set which is NOT provided in the package!
What does this package include?
3D Modeling of a Hamster Plastic Tunnel Box with textures 4k and 2K (Base Color, Normal Map, Roughness, Metalic, Ambient occlusion, Opacity)
Important notes

  - File format included - (Blend, FBX, OBJ, STL, Alembic, Collada, Gltf )

  - Texture size - 4K and 2K (Base Color, Normal Map, Roughness, Metalic, Ambient occlusion, Opacity)

  - Uvs non - overlapping

  - Polygon: Quads Low poly

  - Centered at 0,0,0

  - Textures, materials, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management

  - In some formats may be needed to assign textures, materials for transparency and add HDR Environment Textures Images for lighting.

  - Not lights include

  - Actual measurements

  - Renders preview have not post-processing

  - No special plugin needed to open scene

If you like my work, please leave your comment and like it helps me a lot to create new content.
If you have any questions or changes about colors or another thing, you can contact me at we3domodel@gmail.com.

description_text:
ENGLISH:Marge tells the audience that the episode is so scary that Congress will not allow its broadcast and instead presents the fictional 200 Miles to Oregon starring Glenn Ford. Homer and Bart interrupt the transmission to show the episode anyway.
The ShinningThe Simpsons are employed as caretakers at Mr. Burns' mountain lodge while it is closed for the winter. Groundskeeper Willie discovers that Bart can read his mind, and tells him he has the Shinning. Mr. Burns cuts off the lodge's cable TV and beer supplies to ensure hard work from the caretakers. The deprivation drives Homer insane (as Waylon Smithers said happened with the previous caretakers).
A phantom Moe Szyslak encourages Homer to kill his family. Marge finds Homer's manuscript, which reads Feelin' fine; lightning flashes, and she sees that Homer has scrawled No TV and no beer make Homer go crazy all over the walls. Homer attacks Marge and she fends him off; Homer faints in horror upon seeing his crazed reflection in a mirror. Marge locks Homer in the pantry. Homer is temporarily distracted by the plentiful food there, but Moe forcibly drags him out. Bart uses his Shinning to summon Willie, who drops his portable TV in the snow to come to the family's rescue. Homer kills Willie with an axe and continues pursuing the family. Lisa shows Homer Willie's TV, and Homer's insanity abates as the family watches TV. After they are frozen stiff, the Tony Awards ceremony begins airing on the TV, and Homer's murderous impulse comes back.
Time and PunishmentHomer accidentally turns his broken toaster into a time machine after trying to repair it. After traveling to prehistoric times, Homer remembers his father's advice about the butterfly effect but unthinkingly swats a mosquito. He returns to a present where Ned Flanders is the unquestioned lord and master of the world; after Homer gets the Simpsons sentenced to 're-Neducation' (a program which includes full-frontal lobotomies), he escapes to the past in an effort to restore the original timeline.
Homer's failed attempts create a present where Bart and Lisa are giants, one where the Simpsons are wealthy and Patty and Selma have died, but no one knows what donuts are, and one where Willie is stabbed in the back with an axe by a talking Maggie. At last he returns to a present where he confirms from Marge that everything is back to normal. He sits down to dinner but sees that Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie have reptilian tongues. Homer accepts this timeline as close enough.
Nightmare CafeteriaPrincipal Skinner and Lunchlady Doris are stymied by the problems of poor cafeteria food and an overcrowded detention hall. After Jimbo Jones trips Lunchlady Doris and gets food slop on him, Skinner realizes a mutual solution: cannibalizing any child that is sent to detention. Jimbo is killed and made into Sloppy Jimbos.
The teachers all become addicted to the mix of food slop and human meat, compelling Skinner to send Üter to detention for cutting in line and turn him into Üterbraten. Bart and Lisa realize this after Skinner unwittingly reveals the truth. They tell Marge, who refuses to help them because she wants them to stand up for themselves. With the other students either dead or imprisoned for fattening up before slaughter, Willie tries to help Bart, Lisa, and Milhouse escape, but Skinner stabs him in the back with an axe. Milhouse, Bart, and Lisa fall off a ledge into a giant food processor. Bart wakes up in his bedroom and realizes he was having a nightmare. Marge assures him he has nothing to fear except the fog that turns people inside out, which seeps in through the window and turns the Simpson family inside out. The family, joined by Willie, perform One from A Chorus Line as the credits roll and Santa's Little Helper, excited by the exposed meat, drags Bart away.
THE MODEL COMES WITH A BASE.
Z: 125mm.
SPANISH:
Marge le dice a la audiencia que el episodio es tan aterrador que el Congreso no permitirá su transmisión y, en su lugar, presenta el ficticio 200 Millas a Oregón, protagonizado por Glenn Ford. Homer y Bart interrumpen la transmisión para mostrar el episodio de todos modos.
El ResplandorLos Simpson trabajan como cuidadores en la cabaña de montaña del Sr. Burns mientras está cerrada por el invierno. El jardinero Willie descubre que Bart puede leerle la mente y le dice que tiene El Resplandor. El Sr. Burns corta el suministro de televisión por cable y cerveza de la cabaña para asegurar el trabajo duro de los cuidadores. La privación vuelve loco a Homer (como Waylon Smithers dijo que sucedió con los cuidadores anteriores).
Un fantasma, Moe Szyslak, anima a Homer a matar a su familia. Marge encuentra el manuscrito de Homer, que dice Me siento bien; un relámpago destella y ve que Homer ha garabateado Sin televisión y sin cerveza, Homer se vuelve loco por todas las paredes. Homer ataca a Marge y ella lo rechaza; Homer se desmaya horrorizado al ver su reflejo enloquecido en un espejo. Marge encierra a Homer en la despensa. Homer se distrae temporalmente con la abundante comida, pero Moe lo saca a la fuerza. Bart usa su Resplandor para llamar a Willie, quien deja caer su televisor portátil en la nieve para rescatar a la familia. Homer mata a Willie con un hacha y continúa persiguiéndolos. Lisa le muestra a Homer el televisor de Willie, y la locura de Homer se calma mientras la familia ve la televisión. Después de que se quedan paralizados, la ceremonia de los Premios Tony comienza a transmitirse en el televisor, y el impulso asesino de Homer regresa.
Tiempo y CastigoHomer convierte accidentalmente su tostadora rota en una máquina del tiempo después de intentar repararla. Después de viajar a la prehistoria, Homer recuerda el consejo de su padre sobre el efecto mariposa, pero sin pensarlo, mata un mosquito. Regresa a un presente donde Ned Flanders es el indiscutible amo y señor del mundo; después de que Homer condene a los Simpson a reeducación (un programa que incluye lobotomías frontales completas), escapa al pasado para intentar restaurar la línea temporal original.
Los intentos fallidos de Homer crean un presente donde Bart y Lisa son gigantes, uno donde los Simpson son ricos y Patty y Selma han muerto, pero nadie sabe qué son las donas, y otro donde Willie es apuñalado por la espalda con un hacha por una Maggie parlante. Finalmente, regresa a un presente donde Marge le confirma que todo ha vuelto a la normalidad. Se sienta a cenar, pero ve que Marge, Bart, Lisa y Maggie tienen lenguas de reptil. Homer acepta esta línea temporal como bastante parecida.
Cafetería de PesadillasEl director Skinner y la recepcionista Doris se ven frustrados por los problemas de mala comida en la cafetería y un centro de detención abarrotado. Después de que Jimbo Jones haga tropezar a la recepcionista Doris y lo manche con comida chatarra, Skinner encuentra una solución mutua: devorar a cualquier niño que sea enviado a detención. Jimbo es asesinado y convertido en Jimbos Descuidados.
Todos los profesores se vuelven adictos a la mezcla de comida chatarra y carne humana, lo que obliga a Skinner a enviar a Üter a detención por colarse en la fila y convertirlo en Üterbraten. Bart y Lisa se dan cuenta de esto después de que Skinner, sin querer, revela la verdad. Se lo cuentan a Marge, quien se niega a ayudarlos porque quiere que se defiendan. Con los demás estudiantes muertos o encarcelados por engordar antes del sacrificio, Willie intenta ayudar a Bart, Lisa y Milhouse a escapar, pero Skinner lo apuñala por la espalda con un hacha. Milhouse, Bart y Lisa caen de una cornisa a un procesador de alimentos gigante. Bart despierta en su habitación y se da cuenta de que estaba teniendo una pesadilla. Marge le asegura que no tiene nada que temer, excepto la niebla que trastorna a la gente, que se filtra por la ventana y trastorna a la familia Simpson. La familia, acompañada por Willie, interpreta One de A Chorus Line mientras aparecen los créditos finales y el Ayudante de Santa, emocionado por la carne expuesta, se lleva a Bart.
EL MODELO VIENE CON BASE.
Z: 125mm.

description_text:
Fantasy Creature Design - The Sunterpillar
Hi and welcome to my unique creature design showcase. I always loved fantasy creatures and imagining how they would have evolved in a different world to ours, on a very unique environment far from what we are used to.For this design I thought: "What if a caterpillar managed to evolve to a point where it became much more mobile, dangerous and simultaneously more resilient? And so it did!
I hope you like The Sunterpillar (I named it sunterpillar, because if you look at it from the front, the scales on it's head reminds us of the sun shape)!
Royalty Free Fantasy Creature Design for your projects!
The native 3D model was modeled on Blender, Sculpted on zBrush, Textured on Adobe Substance Painter and finally brought together back on Blender 3.5 and exported on other formats for your needs.The textures are @ 2K resolution.The model is low-poly and PBR.The model is rigged for animation.
The native file is a .blend, however you'll find an .fbx, an .obj & .mtl, a .glTF and an .stl file format included with your purchase.

description_text:
A fishing vessel is a boat or ship used to catch fish in the sea, or on a lake or river. Many different kinds of vessels are used in commercial, artisanal and recreational fishing.
The total number of fishing vessels in the world in 2016 was estimated to be about 4.6 million, unchanged from 2014. The fleet in Asia was the largest, consisting of 3.5 million vessels, accounting for 75 percent of the global fleet.[1] In Africa and North America the estimated number of vessels declined from 2014 by just over 30,000 and by nearly 5,000, respectively. For Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean and Oceania the numbers all increased, largely as a result of improvements in estimation procedures.[2][1]
It is difficult to estimate the number of recreational fishing boats. They range in size from small dinghies to large charter cruisers, and unlike commercial fishing vessels, are often not dedicated just to fishing.
Prior to the 1950s there was little standardisation of fishing boats. Designs could vary between ports and boatyards. Traditionally boats were built of wood, but wood is not often used now because of higher maintenance costs and lower durability. Fibreglass is used increasingly in smaller fishing vessels up to 25 metres (100 tons), while steel is usually used on vessels above 25 metres.

*What is a Sivatherium?*
Sivatherium (Shiva's beast, from Shiva and therium, Latinized form of Ancient Greek θηρίον - thēríon) is an extinct genus of giraffids that ranged throughout Africa to the Indian subcontinent. The species Sivatherium giganteum is, by weight, one of the largest giraffid known, and also one of the largest ruminants of all time. The Afro-Asiatic species, S. maurusium, was once placed within the genus Libytherium.
Sivatherium originated during the Late Miocene (around 7 million years ago) in Africa and survived through to the late Early Pleistocene (Calabrian). Giganteum remains have been recovered from the Himalayan foothills, dating around 1 million years ago. Suggestions have been made that S. maurusium may have gone extinct as recently as 8,000 years ago, as depictions that resemble it are known from ancient rock paintings in the Sahara and Central West India. But these claims are not substantiated by fossil evidence, and the depictions likely represent other animals.

What is a Short-Faced Bear?
The short-faced bear (Arctodus sp.) is an extinct bear genus that inhabited North America during the Pleistocene epoch from about 1.8 Mya until 11,000 years ago. It was the most common tremarctine bear in North America and many of its fossils have been found in the La Brea tar pits in southern California. There are two recognized species: the lesser short-faced bear (Arctodus pristinus) and the giant short-faced bear (Arctodus simus), with the latter considered to be one of the largest known terrestrial mammalian carnivores that has ever existed. It has been hypothesized that their extinction coincides with the Younger Dryas period of global cooling commencing around 10,900 BC.

description_text:
The Tuunbaq from The Terror - - 3D Print Model
I'm very excited to announce the brand new STL FanMade Model ! This Model presents The short-faced bear (Arctodus sp.) is an extinct bear genus that inhabited North America during the Pleistocene epoch from about 1.8 Mya until 11,000 years ago.
The figure is cut/printed/painted ready to go
Thanks a lot !:)
What is The Tuunbaq?
The Tuunbaq is a monstrous spirit bear creature which appears in the novel and AMC TV series The Terror. It is a creation by Dan Simmons, author of the novel, and is possibly based on the Inuit mythology of the Tupilaq, a vengeful spirit that takes the form of both man and animal._ All rights reserved

description_text:
A 3D-Printable model of the eurypterid walker from the Dinotopia books - it didn't have too big a role but the books are quite heavy on detailed descriptions and worldbuilding and these ancient mechs found udnerground without much further explanation are somewhat fascinating - this one was built resembling an eurypterid, more commonly known as a prehistoric sea scorpion (though technically hteir exact relationship with scorpions is a bit more distant) and works as an amphibious one man vehicle. The model is full scale so you can scale it to whatever size you want. There are individual parts that clip together for a movable version, a full STL of the entire machine and a SolidWorks assembly with the parts linked together so you can easily move nad pose the mech and the nexport a full stl if you have SolidWorks.
The Model was designed to be scaled down something around 1/20 but smaller or larger scales are possible too - it's full scale overall length is about 10 meters.
When printing in parts it is recommended to make the tail with more infill / wall thickness to somewhat balance out the center of mass and get it to stand on it's legs well.
I won't upload any of the original references as preview images due to copyright but if you like you can look the mup, some of them are easy to find - or get the books, they're really good.

description_text:
Stunningly realistic set of 4 snake skulls, created from scanned specimens for an awe-inspiring display of nature’s artistry.

  - Python

  - Boiga

  - Cobra

  - Viper 

This set contains digital 3D models of four authentic serpent skulls, perfect for creating realistic replicas. The download contains uncut whole skulls (OBJ) and parts with connection pegs (STL) for better printing.
The download contains pieces of the model ready to be 3D printed on a 200 mm print bed and also files that are not cut into smaller pieces. All cut parts are placed on the print bed as we would print them to save you time. The individual pieces need to be glued together.
SIZEAt 100% scale, the model’s dimensions are approximately:Width 70 mmLength 139 mmHeight 53 mmYou can scale the model as you wish but we can’t guarantee that at a much smaller size, the model will print well.
3D PRINTING SETTINGSWe recommend printing the skull on an SLA 3D printer to preserve as many of the details as possible.If you only have an FDM printer we recommend using these settings:Layer height 0.1 mmInfill 15%Supports 45°
For parts that are tall but have a small base, we use a 10 mm brim for better bed adhesion.Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don’t have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3d printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic. We’ve been making 3D printable models for more than a decade. We make a lot of cosplay accessories but we also make all sorts of interesting 3D models. You find us on most social media platforms.

description_text:
This is a pack of low poly hand painted books and scrolls including animated books. We have added 57 prefabs in this .unitypackage which are perfect for any fantasy medieval third person/topdown RPG environment. We also have added candles, inkpot and quill, scroll holder, and two separate scenes including all prefabs. 
PACKAGE CONTENT We have included following items in separate folders with this package : 

  - books_and_scrolls_vol.2.unitypackage 

  - .max files 

  - .fbx files 

  - Texture file (.tga format)

UNITY PACKAGE The unity package contains : 

  - Total 57 prefabs including closed books, open books, book rows, book stacks, mixed stacks, animated books, map scrolls, scrollholder, candles, inkpot and quill 

  - One hand painted texture atlas (2048x2048px) for all books and scrolls, scroll holder, inkpot and quill 

  - One hand pained texture atlas (512x512px) for candles 

  - One hand painted emission map (256x256px) for candles 

  - Candle flame sprite sheet in two resolutions (1024x1024px and 1024x512px) 

  - Candle flame particle 

  - Total 24 prefabs for four different categories of animated books 

  - A C# script file for interactive book animation 

  - Two separate scenes including all prefabs. 

  - Documentation 

PREFABS

  - 9 closed books 

  - 6 open books 

  - 24 animated books 

  - 4 map scrolls 

  - 4 book rows 

  - 4 book stacks 

  - 2 mixed stacks 

  - Scroll holder 

  - 2 candles (with animated flame) 

  - Inkpot and quill 

ANIMATIONSWe have included 4 types of animated books : 

  - Book open and book close 

  - Book open, multiple pageflip, book close 

  - Single page flip 

  - Multiple page flip 

MAX MODELS All of the 23 .max models are UV mapped. Materials are not included.
FBX MODELS 23 .fbx models
TEXTURE 

  - One hand painted texture atlas (2048x2048px) for all books and scrolls, scroll holder, inkpot and quill

  - One hand pained texture atlas (512x512px) for candles 

  - One hand painted emission map (256x256px) for candles 

  - Candle flame sprite sheet in two resolutions (1024x1024px and 1024x512px) 

POLYCOUNT

  - Books : 62 - 280 

  - Candles : 207 - 237 

  - Scrolls : 20 - 232 

  - Scroll holder : 156 

  - Inkpot and quill : 290 

DISCLAIMER 
The wood and stone textures used in the display image are not included in the package.If you have any doubts please contact us via our profile page or email us at : jay.artistry@gmail.com.

description_text:
• Let me present to you high-quality low-poly 3D model Etuline Perfecta T882G tablet. This model can be used in various fields 3D Graphics such as game development, advertising, interior design, motion picture art, visualization, etc.. Modeling was made with ortho-photos of real tablet that is why all details of design are recreated most authentically
•    Ease of use consists of one mesh, it is low-polygonal and it has only one material.
• The well topology of low-poly model with combination of detailed textures allows to get the best quality with a minimum number of polygons, which can be enough even for closeup.
• To increase advanced realism these textures are used - Specular, Glossiness, Bump and Emission for the luminous elements of the model (For example, screens, indicators, etc.). If you use V-Ray renderer and V-Ray MTL materials set “BRDF Type” as “Phong” for correct glossiness effect. For correct reflecting effect you need to set “Use Fresnel” and “Fresnel IOR” is 5. For the best Bump depth we set “Bump Multiplier” is 0.1 - 0.2.
• The total of the main textures is 5. Resolution of all textures is 4096 pixels square aspect ratio in .png format. Also there is original texture file .PSD format in separate archive.
• The model was created in the Maya 2009 3D program. 
• The model has correct dimensions in real-world scale in centimeters. All parts grouped and named correctly.
• Also, there is a prepared render-scene created in the Maya 2014 with renderer plug-in V-Ray 2.40. This scene opens correctly in earlier versions up to the Maya 2012 with V-Ray 2.0 because it is saved in the .ma format. Render-scene includes 6 V-Ray Rect Light + reflectors. The V-Ray MTL materials are assigned to model. On Timeline was set animation keys for model and Render Camera position relevant Preview Images. If you don’t need these positions don’t forget to delete animation keys from translation and rotation channels.
• To use the model in other 3D programs there are scenes saved in formats .fbx, .obj, .DAE, .max(2010 version).
Note: This is the Low-Poly model and it is not designed for the use of any smoothing modifiers.

description_text:
The weight of 18 carat gold of this swan ring is 22 grams and 94 whistles.Swan Meaning and Swan SymbolismExploring the Depths of Swan Meaning
Our first symbolic clues about symbolic swan meaning can be taken from observing them in nature. They are waterfowl, closely connected with water, even nesting near the water.  Water is symbolic of: Fluidity, Intuition, Dreaming, Emotions, Creativity.
In this respect, we can intuit the swan’s appearance in our lives as an arrow pointing to our dreamier depths and feelings. Furthermore, we get the sense of balance from swan meaning as it lives harmoniously amongst three of the four Aristotelian elements. Grounding herself on earth, lofting to great heights in the air, and winding through waters with magnificent elegance.The concept of partnership is further expressed on a divine level in Hinduism, wherein the swan graces vibrant traditions as the Hamsa bird. In the Saundarya Lahari (translated: “Waves of Beauty,” it’s a text filled with beautiful mantras from the Hindu perspective) two swans (Ham and Sa) pair together, swimming around in the divine mind “living on honey from the blooming lotus of knowledge.” Isn’t that a lovely concept?
In the Celtic mind, swans and geese were observed in the context of movement. Specifically, the keenly observant Celts noted their transitory nature and the swan pattern of migration. Consequently, the sign of the swan urged Celtic intuition to consider changes of mood (water) and heart (love).
Swan meaning is also linked to Celtic deities with solar associations, like Belanus and Lugh. As solar animals, the swan represents the rising glory of a new day as well as the farewell of an old day with the setting sun.

description_text:
Predator_X Model
Pliosaurus (meaning 'more lizard') is an extinct genus of thalassophonean pliosaurid known from the Kimmeridgian and Tithonian stages (Late Jurassic) of Europe and South America. Their diet would have included fish, cephalopods, and marine reptiles. This genus has contained many species in the past but recent reviews found only six to be valid, while the validity of two additional species awaits a petition to the ICZN. Pliosaurus currently consists of the type species P. brachydeirus, and also P. brachyspondylus, P. carpenteri, P. funkei, P. kevani, P. macromerus, P. rossicus and P. westburyensis, as well as the invalid P. portentificus. Most species of Pliosaurus are notable for their large body size, while the others, P. brachydeirus, P. brachyspondylus and P. portentificus, are known exclusively from immature individuals. Species of this genus are differentiated from other pliosaurids based on seven autapomorphies, including teeth that are triangular in cross section.

description_text:
Angler Fish
No riggedNo UV mapThe anglerfish are fish of the teleost order Lophiiformes (/ˌlɒfiɪˈfɔːrmiːz/).[1] They are bony fish named for their characteristic mode of predation, in which a modified luminescent fin ray (the esca or illicium) acts as a lure for other fish. The luminescence comes from symbiotic bacteria, which are thought to be acquired from seawater,[2][3] that dwell in and around the sea.
Some anglerfish are notable for extreme dimorphism and symbiosis of the small male with the much larger female, seen in the suborder Ceratioidei, the deep sea anglerfish. In these species, males may be several orders of magnitude smaller than females.[4]
Anglerfish occur worldwide. Some are pelagic (dwelling away from the sea floor), while others are benthic (dwelling close to the sea floor). Some live in the deep sea (such as the Ceratiidae), while others on the continental shelf, such as the frogfishes and the Lophiidae (monkfish or goosefish). Pelagic forms are most often laterally compressed, whereas the benthic forms are often extremely dorsoventrally compressed (depressed), often with large upward-pointing mouths.[citation needed]

description_text:
3D model of fish as a pendant in the dimensions of 34.6 * 22.4 mm
Biomimicry or biomimetics is the science that studies nature as a source of inspiration for the design of innovative solutions (technological, architectural, process…) to solve human problems.The main idea behind biomimetics is that nature is millions of years ahead of humans in any field, and for that reason it’s very advantageous to be inspired by it or to copy it directly. The term was popularized by scientist and author Janine Benyus with her book “Biomimicry: Innovation Inspired by Nature” in 1997. In the book she talks about a new science that studies the models of nature and then imitates these designs and processes to solve human problems. “Today we are faced with a challenge that calls for a shift in our thinking, so that humanity stops threatening its life-support system. We are called to assist the Earth to heal her wounds and in the process, heal our own – indeed to embrace the whole of creation in all its diversity, beauty and wonder.” ~ Wangari Maathai
As the world becomes more in tuned with the planet’s plight, more industries have chosen to make the commitment to Going green. The jewellery industry is no different. Interestingly, the designers have taken different approaches to help create a culture of sustainability. While they are making a conscientious effort to either embracing or saving nature, they also place high emphasis on the aesthetics and design of the jewellery. Today, we’ll look at three ways designers have incorporated nature into their design:
After a mad rush to establish the concrete jungle, we’ve started to realise just how much of an impact nature has on our physical and emotional wellbeing. Being in nature, or viewing scenes of it, can lift your mood and even reduce stress, muscle tension and blood pressure. Thus, these designers were inspired by nature and incorporated real foliage and flowers into their design.Ocean Petals Art Studio by Jasenka created a collection of botanical pieces that are rustic and feminine. Being an avid gardener, Jasenka grows and collects all the tiny elements that she works with – such as bark and foliage fragments – from her family garden in a sustainable way. Whilst in university she studied Botany, Forestry and Horticulture, where she learnt the art of drying and pressing flowers. To create her jewellery, she preserves them in eco resin to create the intricate pieces. By using this form of resin, she keeps the jewellery eco-friendly while achieving the visual result.Erin LaRocque chose to get her materials through foraging for foliage and wood in Michigan’s Hiawatha National Forest. Because she isn’t manipulating the vegetation, there isn’t an identical pendant within the collection. Just like Jasenka, she also works with resin to preserve her unique findings. She showcases her handmade creations under her online shop her shop BuildWithWood.
Then there are the designers who want their customers to interact with living, growing plants. Passion Flower Made created botanical jewellery by incorporating succulents into the jewellery design. Designer, Susan McLeary, models succulents taken from her garden and creates statement pieces which can stay fresh for up to three weeks. Of course, you’ll need to take care of the creation in the same way you would with your house plants. After that, the client can gently peel them off the jewellery and repot them so that they can continue to thrive. The jewellery underneath is also designed to be a strong stand-alone; giving the client two for the price of one.Icelandic designer Hafsteinn Juliusson had a similar idea and created the Growing Jewellery. This limited-edition collection incorporated moss into handmade pieces fashioned from silver. When well maintained, which includes watering and trimming the moss, the plant can stay green for up to 12 weeks. The clash between organism and couture was in an effort to bring people in metropolitan cities closer to nature.
Our need for instant gratification means we’re going through products faster than ever before. But what happens to your discarded TVs, mobile phone, or computer. Most likely, it ends up in a landfill further contributing to the waste management problem. However, what if it could be broken down and given a second life in jewellery?
Recycled Beautifully was started by Celina Ortiz and her husband to create wire jewellery from spare TV parts. The ‘Tree of Life’ necklaces use cooper and aluminium wires that are found in older versions of TV sets. They are then wrapped around a variety of stones such as agate, opal and turquoise to fashion pendants.Gulnur Ozdagar turned to the most readily available waste-material to create jewellery; PET bottles. Their stellar range of luminous pieces features everything from crowns and earrings to hairpins and necklaces that are all made from upcycling these bottles.Jewellery artist, Dana Hakim Bercovich, gets her inspiration from the metal mesh of speakers. This mesh, which is designed to protect the internal components of the speaker, is moulded to create brooches, necklaces, earrings and bracelets of beautiful geometric shapes.
DonateYou’re design process can already be green, but some designers decide to take it a step further. They either contribute money or resources towards environmental initiatives or try they literally get their hands dirty for more greenery.
Brilliant Earth specialises in engagement rings that are ethically and sustainably made. Apart from using conflict-free diamonds, which are sourced from only ethical mines that observe strict environmental and labour standards, they also work with recycled diamonds and lab created ones too. In addition, they’ve partnered with the environmental non-profit One Sky and the Conservation Society of Sierra Leone to restore land that was ravaged by unregulated mining to organic agriculture practices.
Pame Designs is a fan-favourite among Hollywood celebrities. Its collection of bracelets, rings, earrings and necklaces are designed by Pam Sweeny from sustainable materials that carry meaning and invite conversation. With the aim of preserving and protecting oceans and rivers, she donates a portion of all sales to organisations such as Surfrider and Waterkeeper Alliance.
Nueva in the Spanish language means new. Thus, Anueva Jewellery works with recycled gemstone, gold and silver to create their eco-friendly product. In addition, with each purchase made, designer Jennifer Vinje donates to Plant-It 2020. This organisation plants trees in no-logging zones.

description_text: A rigid inflatable boat (RIB), also rigid-hull inflatable boat or rigid-hulled inflatable boat (RHIB), is a lightweight but high-performance and high-capacity unsinkable boat constructed with a rigid hull bottom joined to side-forming air tubes that are inflated with air to a high pressure so as to give the sides resilient rigidity along the boat’s topsides. The design is stable, light, fast and seaworthy. The inflated collar acts as a life jacket, ensuring that the vessel retains its buoyancy, even if the boat is taking on water. The RIB is an evolutionary development of the inflatable boat with a rubberized fabric bottom that is stiffened with flat boards within the collar to form the deck or floor of the boat.

Scanned model of a small skull that is covered with strange markings. Could be used for some sort of horror setting as an artifact for preforming rituals. Images are rendered using only provided textures. base color = diffuse color. metalness / specular / = black color - no texture. roughness = white color - no texture. Normal map = normal texture. Ambient occlusion = AO. Cavity = bump.

The Lion of Venice is an ancient bronze winged lion sculpture in the Piazza San Marco of Venice, Italy, which came to symbolize the city — as well as one of its patron saints, St Mark — after its arrival there in the 12th century. The Lion sculpture has had a very long and obscure history, probably starting its existence as a winged lion-griffin statue on a monument to the god Sandon at Tarsus in Cilicia (Southern Turkey) about 300 BC.[3] The figure, which stands on the eastern column, at some point came to represent the “Lion of Saint Mark”, traditional symbol of Saint Mark the evangelist. The figure standing on the western column is St. Theodore of Amasea, patron of the city before St Mark, who holds a spear and stands on a crocodile (to represent the dragon which he was said to have slain). It is also made up of parts of antique statues and is a copy, the original being kept in the Doge's Palace.

description_text:
All preview renders were rendered in Blender 2.8 using Cycles renderer with physically based Principled BSDF shader. Render setup utilizes 16384x8192 HDRI image lighting map (included).Textures are optimized for PBR rendering solutions (using Metalness or Specular workflows).Level 4 subdivision modifier is applied to geometry. Beauty renders uses albedo, roughness and vector displacement maps.
GEOMETRY
Geometry provided is low poly mesh. Mesh is subdividable up to its original sculpt level of 6 to accurately reveal all tiny details of displacement map.Model is designed to provide optimal detail/performance level you need. Not only high detail close-up renders are possible, but lower subdivision level/not subdivided mesh can also be used in game environments.

  - Geometry centered on the origin

  - Real world scale (units: centimeters)

  - Polygonal quads only

  - No poles with more than 5 edges

  - Displacement distance (useful in other software packages):  1.0 cm

  - UVs: linear

TEXTURES
Textures are photorealistic 8192x8192 (32 bit per channel EXR) images, created from real object capture data.Each model UV's were created and inspected according to its specific surface characteristic. This enables to find the optimal balance of maximum texture space allocation, intuitive layout, easy further 2d texture editing possibilities and minimal texture distortion.Textures are designed to fit linear UVs (no internal smoothing, locked UV borders) to avoid UV smoothing errors. Geometry of evenly sized quads guarantees low linear UV texture distortion when subdivided.
Textures used in provided Blender scene:

  - Albedo

  - Roughness

  - Vector Displacement

  - Spherical 16384x8192 HDRI map texture

Additional textures provided in separate archive:

  - Normal (for subdivision level 0 geometry)

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Displacement

No third-party plug-ins used.Scene created in Blender 2.8.
Feel free to leave your feedback. It should help me to better know your needs and actual product reception. My goal is to provide high quality models and constantly improve various aspects of them. Thank you!

Dragon Quest (ドラゴンクエスト) is a series of role-playing video games made by Square Enix (originally Enix Corp.) for a variety of video game platforms. It is the all-time best-selling video game series in Japan, and enjoys decent popularity elsewhere as well. The series was referred to outside Japan as Dragon Warrior prior to the release of Dragon Quest VIII due to a trademark issue in the United States.
Each game in the main series of games is titled with the name Dragon Quest followed by a Roman numeral. Since 1986, which marked the release of the original Dragon Quest, Dragon Quest has so far featured eleven games within the main series, as well as several spin-off games, and also two animated productions.
Dragon Quest is often compared with the Final Fantasy series, created by SquareSoft. Although the Dragon Quest series started before Final Fantasy, it continues to lag behind in the number of games within the main series (eleven Dragon Quest titles versus fifteen Final Fantasy titles). The two competed for more or less the same market until the companies' merger in 2003, at which point Dragon Quest began to take a backseat to the more universally popular Final Fantasy.

A Farm Cattle Bakkie Ute Pickup Cage Fowl Poultry Bird Truck Cargo system refers to a specific and integrated agricultural transport configuration designed for the efficient and humane conveyance of various farm animals, with a particular emphasis on poultry and smaller livestock. This comprehensive term encapsulates the vehicle type, the containment method, and the types of cargo typically transported.

At its core, the system utilizes a light utility vehicle, commonly known by regional designations such as Bakkie (Southern Africa), Ute (Australia and New Zealand), or Pickup Truck (North America and globally). These vehicles are characterized by an enclosed cabin and an open cargo bed at the rear, making them highly versatile and indispensable in agricultural environments due to their ruggedness, capacity for varied terrain, and ability to carry significant loads. The terms Truck and Car broadly signify the vehicle platform, with Pickup Truck being the most specific and universally recognized descriptor for this class of utility vehicle in a cargo context.

The critical component for animal transport within this system is the Cage. These are purpose-built containment units, often constructed from durable plastic, wire mesh, or aluminum, designed to securely hold live animals during transit. For Fowl, Poultry, and other Bird species, these cages are meticulously designed with features that ensure adequate ventilation, secure locking mechanisms to prevent escape, and a stackable design to maximize cargo density while minimizing stress and injury to the animals. While Cattle is included in the descriptive phrase, the cage aspect typically pertains to smaller or juvenile livestock such as calves, sheep, or goats, rather than adult large cattle, for which different transport trailers are used. The primary application, as indicated by Fowl, Poultry, and Bird, is the transport of chickens, ducks, turkeys, and other feathered species.

The Cargo aspect refers to the live animal load itself and the overall process of its transportation. This methodology is extensively employed in modern agriculture for various purposes, including the movement of broiler chickens or laying hens between farms, to processing facilities, to auction markets, or for inter-farm transfer of breeding stock and young animals. Operational considerations for such transport systems include strict adherence to biosecurity protocols to prevent the spread of diseases, implementation of humane handling practices to mitigate animal stress, and compliance with local, national, and international animal welfare regulations for live animal transport. The maneuverability of the light utility vehicle combined with the specialized, stackable cages makes this system an essential and efficient element in the logistics chain of contemporary animal agriculture.

description_text:
Speed up your creature creation workflow with this clean, professional, and anatomically accurate Dragon & Wyvern Base Mesh / Blockout. Perfect for creature artists, game devs, sculptors, and students looking for a solid, majestic, and imposing foundation for dragons, wyverns, or legendary reptilian beasts.
Features:100% Created in ZBrush: Designed from scratch with a clean production pipeline in mind.
3 Subdivision Levels: The geometry is organized into 3 subdivision levels, allowing you to easily switch from low-poly blocking to high-poly detailing.
Organized SubTools & Polygroups: Each anatomical part of the dragon structure is separated into its own SubTool and color-coded with clean Polygroups for effortless selection, masking, and sculpting. Separated parts include:
HEAD & JAWS
TORSO / NECK
WINGS (Wyvern/Dragon style)
LEGS
Versatile Design: Balanced and intimidating proportions, perfectly suited for realistic fantasy monsters, RPG bosses, or stylized/anime creature concepts.
What you will get:.ZTL file (Compatible with ZBrush 2024 and above) with intact SubTools, Polygroups, and 3 subdivision levels.
Universal .FBX file
Universal .OBJ file
Universal .blend file (Blender ready 5.1.2)
  - Note: This is a high-poly/mid-poly blockout and basemesh asset designed for sculpting and concept art. It does not include textures, rigging, or UV mapping

description_text:
Bird feeder high quality original design. With just the right amount of polygons to make it look soft. Ready to be subpatched or subdivided, made from solid parts, after simple mesh automatic repair or boolean operations it can be 3D printed. It will accept perfectly different types of materials. 

  - Easily change colors, 2 or 1 material ideally but made from several pieces.

  - Model to scale, if your software changes the size while importing, use 50 cm or 19.6' wide.

However the model was built to meet the requirements of the protocol. Notably correct topology, UV specifications, size, etc.

  - The model is originally made in Lightwave, other software may require material or color edits.

  - Includes a high subdivision version for stl and obj formats.

  - Formats included: .lwo, .obj, .fbx, .stl, .lxo (.obj contains UV information and is an industry standard that most software can use)

Included are textures. height map and or bump map, color, specular and some complimentary maps.

  - Includes low polygon versions for gaming or faster processing times.

  - Different formats are available upon request.

Before purchasing please review the Assembly Video on Youtube.
This is a model set that will enable you to 3d Printer my concept design of a TFA Beastbox, whom I refer to as The Headbanger. This is the last member of my Knights of Cybertron Rock back (for now)

I do not color name my components as it is User choice as the color scheme is only limited by your imagination. If you are undecided look up some cartoon/comic stills for reference.

--------------------------------------------------------------Ganesha--------------------------------------------------------------
Ganesha also known as Ganapati and Vinayaka, is one of the best-known and most worshipped deities in the Hindu pantheon.  His image is found throughout India, Sri Lanka and Nepal. Hindu sects worship him regardless of affiliations. Devotion to Ganesha is widely diffused and extends to Jains and Buddhists.
Although he is known by many attributes, Ganesha's elephant head makes him easy to identify. Ganesha is widely revered as the remover of obstacles, the patron of arts and sciences and the deva of intellect and wisdom.  As the god of beginnings, he is honoured at the start of rituals and ceremonies. Ganesha is also invoked as patron of letters and learning during writing sessions.
Several texts relate mythological anecdotes associated with his birth and exploits and explain his distinct iconography.
Ganesha emerged as a distinct deity in the 4th and 5th centuries AD, during the Gupta period, although he inherited traits from Vedic and pre-Vedic precursors.  He was formally included among the five primary deities of Smartism (a Hindu denomination) in the 9th century. A sect of devotees called the Ganapatya arose, who identified Ganesha as the supreme deity. The principal scriptures dedicated to Ganesha are the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvashirsa. Brahma Purana and Brahmanda Purana are other two Puranic genre encyclopedic texts that deal with Ganesha.

GaneshaGanesha also known as Ganapati and Vinayaka, is one of the best-known and most worshipped deities in the Hindu pantheon. His image is found throughout India, Sri Lanka and Nepal. Hindu sects worship him regardless of affiliations. Devotion to Ganesha is widely diffused and extends to Jains and Buddhists.
Although he is known by many attributes, Ganesha's elephant head makes him easy to identify. Ganesha is widely revered as the remover of obstacles, the patron of arts and sciences and the deva of intellect and wisdom. As the god of beginnings, he is honoured at the start of rituals and ceremonies. Ganesha is also invoked as patron of letters and learning during writing sessions.
Several texts relate mythological anecdotes associated with his birth and exploits and explain his distinct iconography.
Ganesha emerged as a distinct deity in the 4th and 5th centuries AD, during the Gupta period, although he inherited traits from Vedic and pre-Vedic precursors. He was formally included among the five primary deities of Smartism (a Hindu denomination) in the 9th century. A sect of devotees called the Ganapatya arose, who identified Ganesha as the supreme deity. The principal scriptures dedicated to Ganesha are the Ganesha Purana, the Mudgala Purana, and the Ganapati Atharvashirsa. Brahma Purana and Brahmanda Purana are other two Puranic genre encyclopedic texts that deal with Ganesha.

description_text:
This asset is a photogrammetry of a small wooden birdhouse (23.6 cm by 15.5 cm by 41.6 cm).
It was devised for the videogame industrie.
The images were shooted in Raw format and delighted manually. The scan was done in Reality Capture. The retopology was optimised in Blender, the UV was created automatticaly and packed in a surface density of 77%. The bake was builded in Substance 3D Designer.
The zip file includes a low-poly mesh (95 846 triangles, 47 923 vertices) in Obj, Fbx and Stl format with a set of 4k Png and 2K Png PBR textures (diffuse, normal, roughness, metallic, height).
The total file size counts 286 Mo (Obj: 6.88 Mo, Fbx: 3.82 Mo, Stl: 4.57 Mo, 2k Png Diffuse: 22.3 Mo, 2k Png Height: 5.91 Mo, 2k Png Metallic: 18.9 Ko, 2k Png Normal: 23.9 Mo, 2k Png Rougness: 3.95 Mo, 4k Png Diffuse: 85.9 Mo, 4k Png Height: 21.3 Mo, 4k Png Metallic: 72.6 Ko, 4k Png Normal: 92.6 Mo, 4k Png Rougness: 15.1 Mo)

description_text: This is my famous 3D-TREX or 3D-REX as I affectionately call him. This dinosaur has moving arms and a moving mouth due to an internal connected structure which I designed exclusively for this model and for other future works. This structure allows the jaw to move when the arms are moved up and down and vice versa while remaining completely hidden, unlike most moving models you see on sites such as Thingiverse. Works as both a small or large print, however, the movement is much larger when the print is larger. If you print it big enough you can even let it roam your office or kids room biting the fingers or hands of anyone who comes too close. Version 3.0 is has a completely contained system and the greatest movement of any modelVersion 2.0 is less hidden and has some gaps but has less degree of motion

Tyrannosaurus] is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The species Tyrannosaurus rex (rex meaning king in Latin), often called T. rex or colloquially T-Rex, is one of the best represented theropods. Tyrannosaurus lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of rock formations dating to the Maastrichtian age of the Upper Cretaceous period, 68 to 66 million years ago. It was the last known member of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event. Tyrannosaurus was a bipedal carnivore with a massive skull balanced by a long, heavy tail. Relative to its large and powerful hind limbs, the forelimbs of Tyrannosaurus were short but unusually powerful for their size, and they had two clawed digits. The most complete specimen measures up to 12.3–12.4 m (40.4–40.7 ft) in length, though T. rex could grow to lengths of over 12.4 m (40.7 ft), up to 3.66–3.96 m (12–13 ft) tall at the hips, and according to most modern estimates 8.4 metric tons (9.3 short tons) to 14 metric tons (15.4 short tons) in weight.

Geonosian Head & Wings 3D Model – Minifigure Compatible 
Bring the hive world of Geonosis to your custom minifigure collection with this detailed 3D model of a Geonosian’s head and wings! Inspired by the insectoid warriors seen in Star Wars: Attack of the Clones and The Clone Wars, this set is designed for perfect integration with standard minifigures—ideal for epic battle scenes, custom armies, and collectors.
Highly detailed sculpt of the Geonosian head and wings Minifigure scale – designed for seamless customization 3D print-ready – high-resolution STL files included
Who are the Geonosians?
The Geonosians are an insect-like species native to the planet Geonosis. Known for their role in constructing the Death Star and their brutal gladiatorial arenas, they played a key part in the rise of the Separatist movement. Their warriors, with buzzing wings and hardened exoskeletons, fought fiercely in the Clone Wars and became iconic enemies of the Republic.
Swarm your minifigures with the might of the Geonosian hive using this dynamic head and wing set – a must-have for Star Wars custom builders!

Figure incontournable de la culture russe, l'ours apparaît souvent dans le folklore, les œuvres littéraires, les proverbes et la culture populaire en Russie. ENGLSIH:
“My name Raymond, but everybody call me 'Ray'.”
Raymond, commonly known as Ray, is a major character in Disney's 2009 animated feature film The Princess and the Frog. He is a Cajun firefly with a romantic infatuation with the evening star, Evangeline.
Ray was an old firefly residing in the Louisiana Bayou of New Orleans alongside his massive family. His worn-down and damaged appearance have significance, indicating a rough and interesting history throughout his life.
At some point in time, Ray met and fell in love with the Evening Star, known as Evangeline; he sees her as a goddess and proves to be quite attached to her. Though it appeared that Evangeline was nothing more than a star, fireflies were revealed to become stars once they die, heavily implying that Evangeline was once an actual firefly who eventually passed away. Though, despite her death, Ray's love for her continued to shine brightly. His one dream mentioned in the film was to someday unite with his love.
Z: 100mm.
SPANISH:
Me llamo Raymond, pero todos me llaman Ray.
Raymond, conocido comúnmente como Ray, es un personaje principal de la película animada de Disney de 2009, La Princesa y el Sapo. Es una luciérnaga cajún que siente una fascinación romántica por la estrella vespertina, Evangeline.
Ray era una vieja luciérnaga que residía en el pantano de Luisiana de Nueva Orleans junto a su numerosa familia. Su aspecto desgastado y deteriorado tiene un significado especial, ya que indica una historia difícil e interesante a lo largo de su vida.
En algún momento, Ray conoció y se enamoró de la Estrella Vespertina, conocida como Evangeline; la ve como una diosa y demuestra un gran apego por ella. Aunque parecía que Evangeline no era más que una estrella, se reveló que las luciérnagas se convierten en estrellas al morir, lo que implica que Evangeline fue una luciérnaga real que finalmente falleció. Sin embargo, a pesar de su muerte, el amor de Ray por ella continuó brillando con fuerza. Su único sueño mencionado en la película era unirse algún día con su amor.
Z: 100mm.

He-Man is characterized by his superhuman strength. In most variations, he is the alter ego of Prince Adam. He-Man and his friends attempt to defend the realm of Eternia and the secrets of Castle Grayskull from the evil forces of Skeletor.
This sword is modeled according to pictures of the actual sword used in the franchise. The size is not accurate so you will need to scale it up or down in respect to your preferences.

description_text:
PBR Fantastic medusa low polygonal game ready animated and rigged model. 
Hello everyone! 
This is my collabaration project with my friend - Andrew Krivulya Charly. 
His profile on CGTrader here ---- https://www.cgtrader.com/charly_1
You can use this animated and rigged model in your fantasy games, cinematics or other projects. 
This character is perfect for a 3rd person games. 
There are very high detailed textures which adaptated to PBR specular workflow. 
JPG file format 4096*4096 and 8192*8192.
Medusa animations:
0 - 180 - Iddle181 - 239 - Attack240 - 350 - Attack 2351 - 459 - Walk460 - 540 - Defence541 - 720 - Death721 - 800 - Death 2
In archive you will find:

  - FBX with all animations

  - Maya scenes:
  - Medusa_only_rig_2014.ma

  - Medusa_only_rig_2017.ma

  - Medusa_rig+animation_2017.ma

  - Renders

  - Maps(pbr_spec_workflow)

  - Marmoset scene with a static model, ligths, background and shaders from the video presentation. 

If You want to buy only static model with included Substance Painter, 3dcoat and Marmoset Projects - go to this link --- https://www.cgtrader.com/3d-models/animals/fish/fantastic-medusa

description_text:
Tyrantrum Pokemon (fan art) – 3D PRINT MODEL
Tyrantrum is a massive bipedal dinosaur-like Pokémon that resembles a Tyrannosaurus Rex. It has craggy auburn rock-like scales covering most of its body, while its underbelly is gray and white. It has a large spiny white fringe around its neck.
This model is a printable model of beautiful Tyrantrum pokemon which looks like Tyrannosaurus Rex. This version is fan art style, so if you want in-game style, you can find it also in our website. https://3d-mon.com/3d-model/groupe/unisex3dprintmodel/tyrantrum-pokemon-12-mm-statue/
Files contain pieces of the pokemon ready to be 3D printed and complete pokemon files, that are not cut into smaller pieces.
SCALE
At 100% scale the pokemon ́s dimension are:
Width approx. 125 mm
Length approx. 200 mm
Height approx. 107 mm
You can scale the model as you like
PRINTER SETTINGS
We recommend a layer height of 0.2 to 0.3 mm on FDM printers. All parts are aligned to the printing platform for easy manipulation. Most of the parts need minimal or no use of printing supports to save printing time and filament. For reliable printing, we also recommend setting a brim to the model shell parts, because of their height and low thickness. It will ensure, that the parts will not come off the printing platform during the printing process. Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
If you’d like to suggest what we should do next, check out our pre-order page and fill in your suggestion: 3d-mon.com/preorder
Do you like the model and don't have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3d printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic.Here are some links to our website and social media where you can see more of our creations:
https://3d-mon.com/links/

description_text:
This 3D printable model is a Reptile's Mask from the Mortal Kombat fighting game franchise.
The download contains pieces of the sword ready to be 3D printed on a 200 mm print bed and files that are not cut into smaller pieces. All cut parts are placed on the print bed as we would print them to save you time.
The total dimensions of this model are approx.:
Width: 188 mmLength: 130 mmHeight: 134 mm
You can scale the model as you wish.
3D PRINTING SETTINGS
We use these settings for most of our prints:Layer height 0.2 mmInfill 15%Supports 45°For parts that are tall but have a small base, we use a 10 mm brim for better bed adhesion.
We try to make the models in a way that uses as little support material as possible.This model is meant to be post-processed after printing. This can be glueing, sanding, painting, etc.
Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don't have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3d printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic.Here are some links to our website and social media where you can see more of our creations:
https://3d-mon.com/links/

description_text:
Leaping in from the wilds of the late Cretaceous comes Velociraptor (un-feathered variant)!
While modern media has often associated Velociraptor with a certain popular scifi franchise's large and super-intelligent cloned dinosaurs, the real Velociraptor was a far cry from the resurrected movie-monster version. In life, Velociraptor was actually a small and lightweight predator growing to just a little over 6ft (2m) long from snout to tail but overall was no bigger than a border collie. While possessing nowhere near the intelligence of the antagonist dinosaurs of Hollywood blockbusters, Velociraptors had a moderate brain-to-body proportion and design that was more intelligent than most modern-day reptiles but still less than that of most modern-day birds. While active and decently nimble, the real Velociraptor was not a reptilian ninja with superhuman agility and acrobatic abilities. Finally, due to fossil evidence of earlier ancestors and cousins, along with skeletal features uncovered in the late 90s, we now know that Velociraptors were not scaly beasts but were covered in feathers similar to modern day birds, even possessing wing-feathers that while not capable of flight could still be utilized for running stability, aggressive displays, and possibly even courtship like modern flightless birds such as ostriches.
This model, however, is un-feathered for those who still love the older interpretations of these famous prehistoric hunters. A separate feathered model will be available in the near future.
This model is 1/12 scale of the real Velociraptor, which will scale with other 1/12 scale lines such as Figma, Star Wars Black Series, Marvel Legends, etc. Interestingly, due to the figure's size it will also scale decently with 1/18 scale figure lines as a stand-in for the Hollywood Velociraptors, such as Jurassic World Hammond Collection, Star Wars Vintage Collection, and more!
This print is designed currently for SLS nylon through Sculpteo.com using polished 60um tolerance nylon. It has not been tested in any other material or process so far, printing through any other way or material should be done at user’s discretion.
When using SLS Nylon from sites such as Sculpteo, only use raw or polished finishes for either PA12 or PA12 (HD-60μm). Avoid using Chemically-Smoothed option as this will cause joints to be too loose and will not hold poses. No other materials have been tested for this print, be it professional or home-printers, so print and experiment at your own discretion.

description_text:
Mystic Fantasy Butterfly is a high-quality stylized 3D creature model, created entirely from scratch and designed to meet professional production standards.
The entire sculpt was made in ZBrush, with a strong focus on clean forms, readable silhouette, and fine surface details. Special attention was paid to the design of the wings, ensuring a unique fantasy look while maintaining visual balance and structural clarity.
The model uses one 4K (4096×4096) texture set, making it efficient and easy to integrate into different pipelines. All textures are hand-painted, and the PBR materials were carefully crafted in Substance Painter to ensure physically accurate results across various rendering engines.
This model is fully production-ready and suitable for:
Games (stylized or semi-realistic projects)
Animation (cinematics, short films, reels)
3D printing (figurines, collectibles)
Fantasy scenes and environments
The topology and overall structure comply with industry standards, making the asset reliable for both real-time and offline workflows. The model is optimized for professional use while maintaining a high level of visual quality.
Perfect for fantasy-themed projects, creature collections, or as a standalone hero asset.
Thank you for your support!

description_text:
This is a model of a Compsognathus AKA Compy
•Modeled in Maya 2011.
•Tweaked and painted in Mudbox 2011.
**USAGE**
•The compsognathus is a widely used dinosaur in many books and movies, and often appear to hunt in large numbers due to their small size. This model was created with the jurassic park compy in mind.
•This model can make game or even clip character due to the very good resolution compared to it's size.
•Easily rigged and easily transferable to a gaming engine like UDK.
**SPECS**
•This model contains 1 object (one compsognathus).
•This model contains 12748 polygons.
** TEXTURES **
•2048x2048 PNG (.png): Diffuse | Specular | Gloss
•4096x4096 PNG (.png): Normal Map
** GENERAL **
•Model is built to real scale following a skeleton reconstruction reference.
•Realistic skin and colors using mudbox.
**RIGGING & ANIMATION**
•This model can easily be rigged and animated as shown in the preview pictures.

description_text:
The Collection of All Parts of my Dimetrodon Loomisi modified for STL 3D Printing
Measurements for the assembled model are approximately: 4.8 in X 11.6 in X 5.7 in ( 12.24 cm X 29.59 cm X 14.58 cm ).
Some assembly required.  Video assembly guide included.
Note 1: This is the result of my first attempt at posing a model before modifying it for the STL format.  As far as I can tell, it turned out pretty well.  Please feel free to offer your own opinions on this model.
Note 2: I've embedded the assembly guide for this model for viewing and critiquing.  Thanks to Alex for his advise on this matter.  The assembly guides for my other models requiring assembly are available for viewing and critiquing on Youtube, and I may embed them as well for the appropriate models.  Please feel free to offer your opinions on them.  The models thus far are the Dilophosaurus, Eolambia, Short-faced Bear, Uintatherium, Dimetrodon, and the newly-added Edaphosaurus.  In order to view the guides on Youtube, just enter the name of the model, followed by "assembly guide".  For the Short-faced Bear, you can alternatively enter the name "arctodus".  For the Dimetrodon and the Edaphosaurus, exclude the species names.

description_text:
This cartoony Gambit rig is made in Maya 2015. The rig is custom and will let you animate all the squash and stretch on the character. Textures are in the PNG format. The zip file comes with a project folder, so please set the project for the textures to show. 
Features of the rig: 

  - IK-FK spine that allows you to squash and stretch 

  - IK-FK stretch arms and legs 

  - Intuitive finger control system for the entire hand as well as individual digits 

  - Staff is rigged to extend and be held in either hands 

  - Playing cards are included as accessories, and can be made to glow/charge 

  - Trench coat can be switched on or off 

  - Model is fully UV unwrapped, textured and comes with edited materials 

  - Detailed facial setup includes on-face sliders 

  - Character can be scaled up or down

NOTES: 

  - Images displayed were rendered using mental ray. But the rig works without mental ray too.

  - Trench coat, staff and playing cards can be switched on or off, and charged by selecting settings_CTRL. 

  - The proxy rig will help speed up the rig in the timeline, and can be accessed through settings_CTRL. 

Please leave a rating/feedback for the item. Hope you enjoy your rig!
